scope: Complete production do_list_transfer and do_mfc; bounded host adapters for VM, vector storage, locks, IRQ, timing, generic DMA; not real GPU/ARM64 concurrency or iPhone gameplay.
limitations: The original zero-element underflow is intercepted by the copy adapter after the initial 16-byte store and before the next 128-byte copy; no four-GiB overwrite is executed.
Native ARM64 instructions, iOS vector-copy specialization, and hardware concurrency are not executed.
